title: Higher Standard of Living while Maintaining Lower Cost of Living
what_it_is: Higher Standard of Living while Maintaining Lower Cost of Living

sections.label: Singapore inflation rates 2010 to 2017
sections.summary: CPI-All Items inflation averaged 1.8% per annum from 2010 to 2017, then fell to 0.6% last year after two years of negative inflation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Between 2010 and 2017, the Consumer Price Index (CPI-All Items) inflation rate was 1.8% per annum.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Last year, the inflation rate was lower, at 0.6%, following two years of negative inflation.

sections.label: Inflation rates of Asian economies
sections.summary: From 2010 to 2017, South Korea and Taiwan had inflation rates of 1.8% and 1.0% per annum, while Hong Kong's was 3.6%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Over the period of 2010 to 2017, the inflation rates of South Korea and Taiwan, at 1.8% and 1.0% per annum respectively, were comparable to or lower than Singapore’s.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: On the other hand, Hong Kong's inflation rate was higher, at 3.6% per annum.

sections.label: Real growth in household income
sections.summary: Median resident household income from work per member grew 3.7% per year in real terms, and lower income deciles grew between 3.6% and 4.0%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: For instance, median resident household income from work per member grew by 3.7% per year in real terms, while that for the lower income deciles rose by between 3.6% and 4.0% per annum.

sections.label: Social transfers and government support
sections.summary: Direct social transfers support lower income groups, and the Government will monitor inflation and cost of living and keep the economy competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Direct social transfers, such as the GST Voucher, Workfare Income Supplement and Silver Support Schemes, provide additional support to the lower income.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: The Government will continue to monitor trends in inflation and cost of living closely and provide help to Singaporeans where required.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: In addition, the Government will continue to ensure that our economy remains competitive and dynamic, so as to provide good job opportunities with sustained income growth for Singaporeans.
